expectations.text: Creates a Markdown design doc under docs/design/ in the project
The document is written in Portuguese, matching the conversation language
expectations.evidence: Entire doc is Portuguese ('## Visão geral', '## Questões em aberto', 'Este documento propõe mover a geração...'). Only tool-canonical fragments (Structurizr DSL keywords, mermaid syntax) are English.

expectations.text: The accepted trade-off — loss of immediate download for small exports — appears explicitly as a cost of the chosen solution
expectations.evidence: 'Trade-offs da solução escolhida' lists '✗ O usuário perde o download imediato — a exportação pequena que hoje resolve na hora passa a chegar por e-mail. Custo aceito em troca do caminho único.' Also stated in Visão geral and Visão da solução.

expectations.text: Alternatives include the two discussed (longer synchronous timeout, external BI tool) and also 'do nothing'
expectations.evidence: 'Alternativas consideradas' has all three: 'Gerar síncrono com timeout maior — descartada... só empurra o problema', 'Ferramenta de BI externa — descartada... pelo custo e por expor dado de cliente', 'Não fazer nada — descartada... ~12% de falha... tickets semanais'.

expectations.text: Cross-cutting concerns cover the platform team (shared queue) and the security team (signed links with PII)
expectations.evidence: '## Preocupações transversais' covers 'Segurança' (link assinado dá acesso a arquivo com PII fora do ciclo autenticado) and 'Plataforma' (fila de exportação no RabbitMQ compartilhado, alinhar volume e limites). Both suggested as reviewers in the header.

expectations.text: A glossary is included or suggested at the beginning of the document covering terms a reviewer could stumble on (e.g. PII, BI, S3); it does NOT carry entries for universally known terms (API, HTTP, URL) nor for the document's own authoring tooling (C4, DSL, Structurizr)
expectations.evidence: Glossary right after the header has exactly three entries: BI, PII, Link assinado. No API/HTTP/URL/CSV entries and no C4/DSL/Structurizr entries. S3 from the assertion's example list is omitted — consistent with the skill's audience calibration, since the suggested reviewers (Plataforma, Segurança) are technical teams that would not stumble on S3.

expectations.text: Every diagram in the doc is followed by explanatory prose (no orphan diagrams)
expectations.evidence: The container diagram (placeholder image + DSL in <details>) is followed by 'O diagrama mostra quatro containers. A API continua sendo a porta de entrada...'; the mermaid sequence diagram is followed by 'O fluxo acima cobre o caminho feliz...'.

expectations.text: No invented facts: every metric in the doc traces to the prompt (30s timeout, 12% failures, 50k/100k rows); unknowns appear as open questions or explicit blanks, never fabricated values
expectations.evidence: Only prompt metrics appear (30s, 12%, 50 mil, 100 mil). Unknowns (autores/revisores, falha do worker, expiração do link, mecanismo de e-mail, limites da fila, observabilidade, transição) live in 7 'Questões em aberto'. No fabricated retry policies, link TTLs or volumes.

expectations.text: The overview section is at most two paragraphs and stays at solution-shape altitude: naming the core mechanism/technology is fine, but no schemas, payloads, endpoints, retry policies, or config values
expectations.evidence: Visão geral is exactly two paragraphs naming the mechanism (enfileirar job, worker em streaming, S3, e-mail com link assinado) and the accepted cost; no schemas, payloads, endpoints, retry policies or config values.
